decisions.reason: Support for dental assistants draws directly on the firm's core customer-service, training and domain know-how, so it can absorb user feedback and keep refining the service at low risk.

The materials management module extends the practice-management core the firm knows well, but its thin web presence suggests limited traction, so it carries moderate risk while the firm learns from early use.
The secure KIM messaging service is part of mandatory telematics infrastructure and is updated through the firm's own development, giving strong absorptive fit and regulatory necessity.
